sources.snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are increasingly integrated into Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) research; however, the field remains fragmented with substantial variation in modeling objectives. sources.title: GitHub - CultureBotAI/PFAS-AI
sources.snippet: This project develops an automated, ML-enabled data pipeline for PFAS biodegradation research, focusing on the identification and characterization of microorganisms capable of degrading per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS). The pipeline integrates multiple biological databases and machine learning approaches to design optimal microbial consortia for PFAS remediation.
